name: Desk by Ouroboros
description: Stores a support team's approved answers, refund rules, escalation limits, and approved commitments so an AI assistant reads policy before it replies. The assistant refuses a refund, feature, or timeline that is not approved and drafts for human review instead. Tools: list_support_desks, create_support_desk, save_approved_answer, search_approved_answers, save_refund_rule, list_refund_rules, save_escalation_limit, list_escalation_limits, save_approved_commitment, list_approved_commitments, evaluate_commitment, evaluate_escalation, get_desk_context. Hosted remote endpoint with OAuth and Dynamic Client Registration; requires an account. Docs: https://ouroborosapps.com/docs/desk. Published in the Official MCP Registry as io.github.LAHutchins91/desk. Made by Ouroboros Apps (https://ouroborosapps.com).
author: Ouroboros
